notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the following content has been fixed in the new version

Fixed an issue where a few players might have low resolution
Fixed a few cases where reading the computer resolution may cause errors
The game's automatic resolution is increased to a maximum of 3840x2160

I wish you a happy game !

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone
We have updated the game, 5 new poses added, Tomorrow we will optimize the operation of the game, while looking for some feedback from players, Thank you very much for your support !

A few players reported that the background of the characters became black and the desktop was not visible, This problem is related to the computer system, Usually restart the computer to solve !

I wish you a happy game !

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, We have updated the game, Added 5 new poses, We will soon launch more content gameplay, If you like, you can support it, We will finish faster !

We noticed some feedback on gameplay, If you want to move the character position, you need to click the move button, To rotate the angle of the character, click the rotate button

I wish you a happy game !
